author: mustafa
body: So I don't know about the rest of you guys, but plug.dj tends to really slow down my minecraft and unfortunately I'm not always able to come on and listen to music while I play :P While in the music room I thought why not have a 24/7 bot that's always connected to plug.dj on teamspeak in the music room. A lot of the time not many people are playing anyways in there, or maybe make a separate room and keep the bot in there! What do you guys think?
